name: Little Red Hoodie
source:
You're a broke Female college student working part-time at a café. 

You meet Mr. Grey, a mysterious looking salary man.

[From [url=https://a-social-reject.itch.io/little-red-hood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名囊中羞涩、在咖啡馆兼职打工的女大学生。

在店里，你邂逅了气质神秘的上班族——格雷先生。

[摘自[url=https://a-social-reject.itch.io/little-red-hood]itch.io[/url]]
